name: fponly-p1
description: fponly-p1: the uniform F-P field at ply 1, the mirror of treeonly-p1 (analyst 6.78: run in parallel; with treeonly-p1 it crosses learner (tree / flat) with data source (tree games / flat games)). F-P x4 playing; OBSERVERS T-P-Ne capped (limit 4, 1M, noise 0.03, forget 1) x2. Seed 60, games_per_cycle 1584, self-games, plateau scaled min 300, cap 400, hybrid17 games, hybrid6 training. Comparators: probit-f10-p1's F-P and capped forget-1 trees. Read: shared with treeonly-p1 (standing ply-1 panel, v150 and the final, plies 1 and 2). Predictions: analyst 6.78.
